hook: A U.S. military operator returning to base over the Mediterranean Sea reported observing a triangular, metallic UAP at 24,989 feet MSL and 168 knots, recorded in a standardized MISREP form. Six of seven pages are fully withheld under 1.4(a), leaving only the GENTEXT section available.
why_it_matters: This MISREP represents the formal, standardized channel through which U.S. military personnel report UAP observations to AARO, demonstrating that triangular metallic UAP sightings are being captured in official military reporting infrastructure. The specific coordinates (363453N 0255943E) place the event over the eastern Mediterranean near the Turkish coast, a strategically sensitive airspace. The near-total 1.4(a) redaction of six pages means the operational context, platform, sensor data, and unit identity remain entirely classified.

key_findings.finding: The UAP was described as triangular and metallic — a specific shape designation entered into the official UAP description field of the MISREP form.

quotes.text: 1X UAP DETECTED WITH DESCRIPTIVE INFORMATION SUCH AS BEING A TRIANGLUAR AND METALLIC UAP.

key_findings.finding: The observation occurred during a return-to-base transit at 1319Z, with the UAP recorded at a precise altitude of 24,989 feet MSL and speed of 168 knots.

quotes.text: DURING RTB AT 1319Z, 1.4(a) OBSERVED 1X UAP WHILE TRANSITING OVER 363453N 0255943E FLYING AT AN ALTITUDE OF 24,989FT MSL AND SPEED OF 168KTS.

key_findings.finding: The UAP was observed at a specific geographic coordinate in the Mediterranean — 363453N 0255943E — placing the event over the eastern Mediterranean Sea.

quotes.text: OBSERVED 1X UAP WHILE TRANSITING OVER 363453N 0255943E FLYING AT AN ALTITUDE OF 24,989FT MSL AND SPEED OF 168KTS.

key_findings.finding: Six of the document's seven pages are entirely withheld under the 1.4(a) classification exemption, concealing all operational context beyond the GENTEXT narrative field.

The report follows the MISREP format with a dedicated UAP Description field and a Gentext UAP Event Description field, reflecting a standardized military reporting structure for anomalous observations.
